comparison.finding: model 2.80 MN (about 285 tf) equals the published test figure; the reported flown nominal is about 250 tf (2.45 MN), 12 % lower

model 6 deg per axis against a reported 15 deg. The catch burn saturates the gimbals (8.5 deg combined is 6 deg on each axis), so the model may understate the flip and braking control authority by more than half. The 15 deg figure is not tied to a version and is not SpaceX-published; confirm before changing the model.
every modelled Raptor gimbals 6-7 deg; the consistent secondary figure is plus/minus 15 deg on two axes. Gimbal rate is not published anywhere found.
